status: prospective, before model fit or test prediction
target: Separate CICIoMT2024 scenario-labelled feature-window study. Classify the window's source scenario as isolated Wi-Fi power-on or one of three published ten-packet attack conditions. Generalization to the original CICIoT2023 rows or new sites is outside this estimand.
benign: All seven Wi-Fi power-on device captures. One independent experiment per isolated power-on device; other profiling streams and aggregate benign files excluded.
attack_scope: Select one representative named capture per distinct mechanism (spoofing, MQTT malformed, discovery). Use only the training-named capture from each. Group any chunks from the same parent together. Skip flood classes to avoid a class-dependent 100-packet aggregation choice. No attack-generation or packet replay.
qualification: Match the distributed source CSV bytes and source PCAP to the selected publisher artifact, verify all PCAPs readable and selected acquisition intervals do not overlap between splits. Use the original 39-feature order, with Duration = packet lifetime per dataset authors Table 5. No filenames, labels, counts of rows, identifiers or session keys enter inference.
assignment: Order benign parent names by SHA256('TON-IOMT-20261123|'+name) with 'Power' file stem as parent; first 3 train, next 2 validation, last 2 test. Use ARP_Spoofing train, Recon-Port_Scan validation, MQTT-Malformed_Data test. No attack subtype shared across splits. Subtype and device effects remain confounded with class support.
sampling: After auditing every row of the ten named source files for finite values and exact and 3-significant-digit cross-split signature matches, use SHA256('TON-IOMT-20261123|'+member_basename+'|'+decimal_header_inclusive_row_number) ascending to select up to 24 finite windows per parent. Sample independent of labels within parent, scores, and overlap. No dropping shared signatures from the sample. Cross-split overlap in the frozen sample stops training per existing runner. Report whole-source overlaps separately.
model: Existing run_content_study.py, code and source identity frozen before fit, existing light logistic, shared Gaussian consumer, validation-only common threshold, alert/summary/full 1/33/313 meaningful bytes.
transport: All frozen test windows. Use six ordered physical miniblocks with all six representation permutations lexicographic (alert,full,summary). Sort test occurrences within parent by the frozen sampling rank, interleave sorted parent names and assign roles cyclically across each triple; offset rotates each generation round so parent and probe are not confounded. Split round triples as evenly as possible over six blocks. Each block repeats the exact same events and roles under each representation, fresh empty queues per block/representation, fixed generation every 1 s, origin creation before encoding, all pending work drained. Flush previous data before new arm. Packet contents solely numeric encodings padded to 256/16384/131072 B. Use total application service of 131072 B/s in 1 s rounds, corrected fair integer grants with cyclic remainder. Three enrolled probes encode; Core decodes and infers solely from completed representation; same-clock return at origin with 1 s inclusive deadline. Primary timely-correct/all generated by representation and equal-parent paired contrasts. Distinguish application service from physical link rate. Keep late, missing, rejected results. Leave per-event wire bytes unknown if link headers/retransmissions cannot be measured. No fitting or evaluation on old physical evidence.
